milestones.name: Escape the cage in Pharloom
milestones.note: Hornet is captured and brought to Pharloom but escapes her cage before arriving at the destination

milestones.name: Ascend to Pharloom's peak
milestones.note: Primary narrative goal: battle foes and solve mysteries to ascend on a deadly pilgrimage to the kingdom's peak

milestones.name: Obtain Bind ability
milestones.note: Bind is a form of Focus that consumes a full Silk spool to regain health (Masks)

abilities.name: Bind
abilities.grants: Consumes a full Silk spool to regain health (Masks); a form of Focus

abilities.name: Needle (slash/block)
abilities.grants: Primary attack; can slash or block attacks from enemies

abilities.name: Needle (grappling hook)
abilities.grants: Used as a grappling hook alongside other abilities

abilities.name: Tools
abilities.grants: Special items equipped on a Crest; used as throwing weapons or defensive aids without costing Silk
abilities.note: Equipped in limited Crest slots; changed at a Bench similar to Charms

bosses.name: Mantis Lords
bosses.note: Killed Elder Hu after he attacked them, mistaking them for Infected

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Travelling sage; became a boss encounter after being killed by the Mantis Tribe; memorial above City of Tears gates

objectives.name: Escape the cage
objectives.hopDescription: Hornet escapes her cage before arriving at Pharloom's destination

objectives.name: Ascend Pharloom to its peak
objectives.hopDescription: Battle foes and solve mysteries while ascending on a deadly pilgrimage to Pharloom's peak

objectives.name: Manage Silk and Masks
objectives.hopDescription: Strike enemies to fill the Silk spool, then use Bind to restore Masks when the spool is full

objectives.name: Equip Tools on a Crest
objectives.hopDescription: Collect Tools and equip them in Crest slots at a Bench to gain throwing weapons or defensive aids

objectives.name: Find Garmond and Zaza
objectives.hopDescription: Encounter the NPC pair Garmond and Zaza who are on a quest to find a new home
objectives.note: Seen in the announcement trailer during the 'New Quests' segment

connectors.description: Hornet ascends through Pharloom toward its peak via a deadly pilgrimage
Elder Hu's journey ended at Mantis Village; his memorial was placed above the gates to the City of Tears
